svg.title: One engine loop: Arena, Deployment, Reflection, and back to the Arena
svg.desc: A loop with no final step. An agent starts with zero lessons in the Arena, where it practises before going live, and passes the eval gate to Deployment, live with real data. Real cases go to Reflection, in seconds and every night, which sends lessons and new practice people back to the Arena, so it gets harder, and lessons for live agents straight into the eval gate. A lesson that passes the gate reaches a live agent as a canary on a small share of chats; a hotfix goes straight to Deployment. One engine: Sales agent, personal assistant, and more.
svg.text: One engine. Sales agent, personal assistant, and more...
